sections.title: Deposit Pricing
sections.note: FDIC national deposit rates: average rates paid across insured institutions (the basis for the national rate caps), via FRED. Monthly from April 2021. Before that, FRED carries the FDIC's earlier weekly non-jumbo series (May 2009 to March 2021), averaged here to months and spliced on; the FDIC changed its methodology in April 2021 (deposit-weighted averages across branches), so levels across that break are not strictly comparable. No break is visible in 2024. Changes on cards are in basis points.

extra.label: Consumer installment loans: net % more willing to lend

sections.note: Federal Reserve Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey on Bank Lending Practices, domestic banks, via FRED. Standards: net % of banks tightening (positive = tighter). Demand: net % reporting stronger demand (positive = stronger). Willingness: net % more willing to make consumer installment loans. Dates are survey months (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct), each covering the prior three months. Mortgage categories begin in 2007 (current definitions 2015); CRE subcategories begin in 2013. Changes are in percentage points vs the prior survey.

quarterly.note: Levels are quarter averages of the weekly (H.8, week-ending Wednesday) or monthly (H.6) data, $bn. YoY = quarter average vs the same quarter a year earlier. LQA = linked-quarter annualized, compounded: ((Q avg / prior-Q avg)^4 − 1). QTD = quarter still in progress (average of the observations so far; hover for count); its YoY/LQA compare that partial average with full prior quarters. Borrowings are NSA, so their LQA includes seasonal swings. H.6 'other liquid deposits' splices savings + OCDs (pre-May 2020) with MDLM. Large-bank C&I = domestic minus small (both Fed H.8). Source: Federal Reserve H.8 and H.6 via FRED.

growth5y.title: Loan & Deposit Growth: Last 5 Years
growth5y.note: Fed H.8, domestically chartered commercial banks (large = top 25 by assets; small = all other domestically chartered banks), weekly (week-ending Wednesday), seasonally adjusted, via FRED. Large-bank C&I = domestic minus small (both Fed H.8). EOP basis = the last weekly reading dated on or before quarter-end (the week used is shown under each quarter). Average basis = average of all weekly readings dated in the quarter. YoY = vs the same quarter a year earlier on the same basis; LQA = linked-quarter annualized, compounded: ((Q / prior Q)^4 − 1), on the same basis. QTD = quarter in progress (EOP = latest week available; average = weeks so far).

deposit_pricing.note: Cumulative beta = change in the product's national rate ÷ change in the effective fed funds rate (monthly averages) between the cycle points, ×100. Turning points are detected from monthly fed funds: the last month at a trough or peak before a move of at least 20 bp in the other direction. A leg ending at the latest month is still in progress.
